text: 16.1 The Service Provider shall process Personal Data strictly in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act") and applicable rules thereunder.
For the purposes of the DPDP Act, 2023, the Customer is the Data Fiduciary and the Service Provider acts as a Data Processor with respect to the Personal Data of Data Principals.
The Vendor shall comply with the SPDI Rules, 2011 and any successor regulations notified under the Information Technology Act, 2000.
